name: GPACKET
recent: Green Packet 正在推进以 5,988,000 令吉收购 A Tech Insure 75% 股权，已支付第二笔款项并开始分期支付余款。公司同时进行最多 598,476,400 股新股（约 30% 股本）的私募配售，并已更改财政年度结束日。最新季度营收环比增长 43.9% 但同比下滑 53.6%，净亏损 980.5 万令吉。
notable: 公司收购 A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd 75% 股权，已支付第二笔款项 RM2,994,000，余款 RM5,988,000 将分五期支付。
公司进行私募配售，最多发行 598,476,400 股新股，约占已发行股份的 30%。
公司更改财政年度结束日。
risks: 私募配售最多发行约 30% 新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
最新季度净亏损 980.5 万令吉，亏损较上一季度扩大。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 3,391.9 万令吉，环比增长 43.9%，同比下滑 53.6%；净亏损 980.5 万令吉，净利率 -28.9%，上一季度为 -22.4%。

recent_en: Green Packet is proceeding with the acquisition of a 75% stake in A Tech Insure for RM5,988,000, having paid the second payment and starting instalment payments for the balance. The company is also undertaking a private placement of up to 598,476,400 new shares (about 30% of share base) and has changed its financial year end. Latest quarter revenue rose 43.9% QoQ but fell 53.6% YoY, with a net loss of RM9.805 million.
notable_en: The company acquired a 75% stake in A Tech Insure Sdn Bhd, paid the second payment of RM2,994,000, with the remaining RM5,988,000 to be paid in five instalments.
The company is undertaking a private placement of up to 598,476,400 new shares, representing about 30% of issued shares.
The company changed its financial year end.
risks_en: The private placement of up to about 30% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Latest quarter net loss was RM9.805 million, widening from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM33.919 million, up 43.9% QoQ but down 53.6% YoY; net loss was RM9.805 million with a net margin of -28.9% versus -22.4% in the prior quarter.
